'''Nogometni klub Šmartno ob Paki''' ({{langx|en|Šmartno ob Paki Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Šmartno ob Paki''' or simply '''Šmartno''', was a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club from [[Šmartno ob Paki]]. The club was dissolved in 2005 due to financial difficulties. Shortly afterwards, a new club under the name of [[NK Šmartno 1928|Šmartno 1928]] was formed. However, they are legally not considered as the successors to the dissolved club and the statistics and track records of the two clubs are kept separate by the [[Football Association of Slovenia]].<ref name = "Klubi">{{cite web | url = https://www.nzs.si/tekmovanja/?action=vsiKlubi&id_menu=35 | title = NZS: Klubi |trans-title=NZS: Clubs | publisher = [[Football Association of Slovenia]] | access-date = 14 December 2024 | language = sl }}</ref>"}}
